pageDesc: Manage visual computing and edge inference packages with safe onboarding, hot scheduling, resource tracking, and uninstallation.
uploadDialogDesc: Upload an algorithm package archive (.tar.gz or .zip, max 500MB). The system will automatically perform blackbox verification and hardware target matching.
clickOrDragToUpload: Click to browse or drag package archive here
invalidFileFormat: Only .tar.gz or .zip package archives are supported
fileTooLarge: Package archive exceeds the 500MB maximum size limit
installSuccess: Algorithm package installed and verified successfully
emptyAlgorithmsDesc: Supports object detection, image classification, face recognition, and person structure packages. Upload a compliant archive to get started.
disableBeforeDelete: Please disable the algorithm package before uninstalling
deleteConfirmDesc: This will physically remove package {{name}} (v{{version}}) and its model weights.
crashLoopSwitchHint: Algorithm is in crash loop; reset the breaker before enabling
transitioningSwitchHint: Algorithm status is transitioning, please wait...
resetDialogDesc: {{name}} crashed repeatedly, so automatic restart has been halted. Resetting only clears the breaker and returns the algorithm to Disabled - it does not restart it, and task bindings are left untouched.
resetDialogChecklistRunnerLog: The runner's stdout / stderr is forwarded into the host log under algorithm={{id}}. Start there to find the crash reason.
resetDialogChecklistOperators: Check that the model and its operators are supported by the target platform (see the RKNN / CANN operator support list).
resetDialogChecklistRuntime: Compare the SDK, driver and ABI versions against the toolchain that built this package.
resetDialogChecklistMemory: Check whether NPU-side DMA / CMA memory is sufficient.
copyAlgorithmIdFailed: Failed to copy, please copy manually
resetSuccess: Breaker cleared. The algorithm is now Disabled.
resetFailedFallback: Reset failed. Please try again later.
resetFailedHint: Make sure the algorithm is still in crash loop, then retry.
impactUnavailable: Could not load the impact summary. Proceed with caution.
impactTasks: {{count}} analysis task(s) will be unbound. Affected cameras: {{cameras}}. The tasks themselves are kept but lose this algorithm.
impactNoTasks: No analysis task is currently bound to this algorithm.
impactEvidenceKept: Historical evidence is preserved: {{recognitions}} recognition(s), {{alarms}} alarm(s) and {{captures}} capture(s) will remain, keeping their algorithm name and version snapshot, but they can no longer be filtered by this algorithm.
impactRequiresStop: This algorithm is currently running; uninstalling will stop its process first.
trialDialogDesc: Upload a single static image (JPEG / PNG, ≤ 10MB) to run one-shot inference in an isolated process. Only available for disabled algorithms.
trialUploadHint: Click or drag and drop an image here
trialSupportedFormats: Supports JPG / JPEG / PNG, resolution ≤ 8192px, size ≤ 10MB
trialErrorFileFormat: Only JPEG or PNG images are supported
trialDisabledOnlyHint: Algorithm must be disabled before running trial
copyJsonFailed: Failed to copy, please copy manually
noSpecificLabels: No specific labels declared in manifest
zeroConfigDesc: This algorithm requires no additional hyper-parameters. It can be directly enabled in analysis tasks.
